sentences.en: Light shines through the large windows outside the picture frame.
sentences.zh: 画面外的大窗户透进光亮。

sentences.en: He came out of the room with his eyes shining.
sentences.zh: 他从房间里出来时眼睛闪着光。

sentences.en: With the sun shining bright, we should go for a swim.
sentences.zh: 阳光明媚，我们应该去游泳。
